gitCommit.subject: fix(childrens-book): photo upload button no longer looks broken before consent (#49)
gitCommit.body:
fix(childrens-book): photo upload button no longer looks broken before consent (#49)

The upload button was disabled until the parental consent checkbox (placed
below it) was ticked, so on the live form it just looked dead. The consent
checkbox now sits above the button, the button stays clickable, and clicking
it without consent highlights the checkbox with a short explanation.
